significance: A hilltop pagoda at Kundahar east of Pokhara in Kaski District, founded in 1817 and dedicated to Bhadrakali as goddess of power and strength; it stands at about 2,930 feet over some 135 ropanies and is reached by stairways of 292 steps from the east and 265 from the south.
story: The goddess is said to have told a priest to dig into the hill, where her image was uncovered and thereafter worshipped as Bhadrakali.
